This model exposes no eligible equation targets for overlay effects.

Use “Equations and files” to reach “Advanced: model file” below, then choose “Export model + overlays (JSON)”.
Edit the exported model in a text editor to define your new inputs and equations, with their units and sources.
Use “Import a model or overlay (JSON)” at the top of the Lab to load and validate the edited file as a new experimental model.

Model-file changes need their own tests and review; they do not extend the original model’s evidence.
